page.layout: Running head at top: page number 652 at left, "Jo. MORINUS" centred. One column of text, full width, with a closing italic dateline. Below: heading "EPIST. LXXXX.", a title line, the address block, and the first word of the letter as a catchword at the lower right. No margin text.

main_text.p: qvibus occupationibus distinear&implicer, qvadantenus informem;ad eam mitto titulum operis, qvod à multis annis elaboro præcipua capita, qvæ in eo edisse-runtur, continentem; operis jam media pars desudata est: qvod restat, sub duobus prælis sudat; opus consummatum iri intra qvadrimestre spero; in his qvæ-stionicus Theologicis & Polyhistoricis, qvas titulus exhibet, recensendis, dispun-gendis, & enucleandis altum otium, qvo abundo, consumpsi, & qvotidie in his emaculandis& edendis consumo. De-us E. T. salvum & in columen Ecclesiæ suæ conservet, summumqve dignitati qva splendes fastigium imponat.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXXXX.
Abr. Ecchellensis J. Morino De Sacerdotum unctionis ritu apud Orientales.
main_text.p: Clarissimo, Doctissimo; Viro Johann. Morino Congreg. Orat. Presb, Abrhamus Ecchellensis S. P. D.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred; the ligatures in "præcipua", "prælis" and "qvæ" are read as æ. "qvadantenus" and "qvæ-stionicus" are read as printed but are doubtful. The line "Postre-" at the foot is treated as the catchword of the next page. No marginal notes on this page.
